name: Shifa Hamid
occupation: Law clerk, City Attorney's office, Rawlins
background: In a Sept. 21, 2026 Wyoming Tribune Eagle candidate questionnaire, Shifa Hamid wrote that she was 28, was employed as a law clerk for the City Attorney in Rawlins, and had been a Wyoming resident for almost 20 years. She described herself as a first-time candidate and said she cared about advocating for Wyomingites.
She was unopposed in the 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 31 and lost the Nov. 3, 2026 general election to incumbent Evie Brennan.

positions.text: Education, human rights (voting, LGBTQIA+ and Indigenous rights) and climate change, addressed through legislation.
Does not support increasing property taxes; would raise excise taxes on alcohol and cigarettes and impose an income tax on corporations only.
Supports larger budgets for the Department of Health, Department of Family Services and the University of Wyoming.

endorsements: Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy (Sway voting group by Tevin (Momala) Davis)
